const {chromium}=require('C:/Users/Administrator/.cache/codex-runtimes/codex-primary-runtime/dependencies/node/node_modules/playwright'),assert=require('node:assert/strict'),{COMBOS}=require('./fighting-core.js');
(async()=>{const b=await chromium.launch({executablePath:'C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/chrome.exe',headless:true}),p=await b.newPage({viewport:{width:1366,height:900}}),errors=[];p.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));await p.goto('http://localhost:4173/fighting.html');await p.selectOption('#mode','local');for(const id of Object.keys(COMBOS))for(let variant=0;variant<2;variant++){const side=variant;await p.locator('#p'+(side+1)+'-roster [data-character="'+id+'"]').click();assert((await p.locator('#move-lists').textContent()).includes(COMBOS[id][variant].name));await p.click('#start');await p.waitForFunction(()=>PixelFighting.snapshot.phase==='fight');await p.keyboard.press(side?'Digit1':'KeyJ');await p.waitForTimeout(360);await p.keyboard.press(side?'Digit2':variant?'KeyK':'KeyJ');if(side&&variant===0)throw Error('Unexpected sequence');await p.waitForTimeout(variant?620:360);await p.keyboard.press(side?'Digit4':'KeyU');await p.waitForTimeout(90);const s=await p.evaluate(()=>PixelFighting.snapshot);assert.equal(s.players[side].moveLabel,COMBOS[id][variant].name,id);await p.keyboard.press('KeyP');await p.click('#new-match');}await p.screenshot({path:__dirname+'/fighting-combo-guide.png',fullPage:true});assert.equal(await p.locator('#move-lists section').count(),2);assert.equal(await p.locator('#move-lists kbd').count(),18);assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);console.log('PASS all six heroes: P1 punch-punch-skill and P2 punch-kick-skill; dynamic move guide; no browser errors');await b.close();})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);});
